policy: Archived files are moved, not deleted. The manifest records the original repository path, archive path, byte size, and SHA-256. Non-audio JSON/MD/LOG files stay in the repository except for the whole legacy demo snapshot.

retained.results/checkpoints/cfvn_v2_best.pt: canonical CFVN; hashed by the v2 report
retained.results/checkpoints/cfvn_v2_arcface.pt: documented raw-ArcFace baseline; scripts/compare_cfvn.py references it
retained.checkpoints/cvae_cfvn_face192_latent128_: canonical CVAE; hashed by the v2 report
retained.checkpoints/style_adapter_cfvn_best.pt: canonical StyleAdapter; hashed by the v2 report
retained.results/naturalness/n1/ami_lora_pilot.pt: N1 negative-result checkpoint; scripts/audit_synthesis_matrix.py uses it
retained.results/naturalness/n1/ami_lora_pilot_la: last-epoch companion to the retained N1 pilot
retained.results/checkpoints/styletts2_lora_proso: StyleTTS2 LoRA pilot checkpoint retained as the 0.741 h result
retained.results/styletts2_lora_eval: 54 WAV paths are referenced by two retained generation-eval JSON files; retaining avoids broken evidence paths
